name: Kniest dysplasia
description: A rare type 2 collagen-related bone disorder characterized by moderately severe chondrodysplasia with disproportionate short stature of prenatal onset, prominent joints with restricted mobility, large epiphyses and dumbbell deformity of the long bones.
